schedule.help:
Schedule format (5 fields):
  minute   hour   day-of-month   month   day-of-week

  minute        0-59     (*/5 = every 5 min,  0 = at :00)
  hour          0-23     (8 = 08:00,  */6 = every 6 hours)
  day-of-month  1-31     (* = every day)
  month         1-12     (* = every month)
  day-of-week   0-7      (0,7 = Sun, 1 = Mon, * = every day)

Examples:
  0 8 * * *      daily at 08:00
  0 * * * *      every hour (at :00)
  0 */2 * * *    every 2 hours
  */30 * * * *   every 30 minutes
  */1 * * * *    every minute (testing only)
  0 0 * * 0      every Sunday at midnight

Short input: */1 → */1 * * * * ; */60 → 0 * * * * ; */120 → 0 */2 * * *
validation.slug_empty: latin letters and digits only (no spaces or cyrillic)

error.schedule_too_many: Too many fields ({count}). Use exactly 5: minute hour day month weekday
error.schedule_too_broad: * * * * * means every minute — too broad. Example: 0 8 * * * or */30 * * * *
error.schedule_minute_interval: Minute field is 0–59. For every hour use */60 or 0 * * * *; every 2 hours: */120 or 0 */2 * * *
